title: Crossmodal Social Cue Integration
summary: How do people combine gaze, facial expression, gesture and voice, especially when social cues across the senses agree or conflict?
question: How do social cues across the senses combine to shape what we perceive and how we respond?
description: Social signals rarely arrive through a single sense. We study when gaze, facial expression, gesture and voice are integrated and when they compete, varying their spatial and semantic congruence in behavioural experiments that inform computational models of multisensory attention.

evidence.title: A trained humanoid robot can perform human-like crossmodal social attention and conflict resolution
evidence.label: IJSR · 2023

evidence.title: What computational models can learn from human selective attention
evidence.label: Review · 2020

zh.title: 计算模型能从人类选择性注意中学到什么
zh.label: 综述 · 2020

evidence.title: A neurorobotic experiment for crossmodal conflict resolution
evidence.label: IEEE/RSJ IROS · 2018

zh.title: 跨模态社会线索整合
zh.summary: 人们如何整合注视、面部表情、手势和语音，尤其是在不同感官通道的社会线索一致或冲突时？
zh.question: 跨感官的社会线索如何整合并影响我们的感知与反应？
zh.description: 社会信号很少只经由单一感官传递。我们研究注视、面部表情、手势与语音何时被整合、何时相互竞争，在行为实验中操控其空间与语义一致性，并据此构建多感官注意的计算模型。

title: Human-Robot Interaction & Cooperation
summary: How do a robot’s social cues and embodiment shape interaction, shared tasks and cooperation between people and robots?
question: How do a robot’s social cues shape cooperation, trust and people’s judgements of the robot?
description: We manipulate robot gaze, facial expression, voice, mirroring and personality in dyadic and multi-party tasks, measuring cooperation, compliance, trust and perceived intelligence. Cognitive robotic simulation lets us evaluate robot behaviour before studies with people.

evidence.title: HRI-Free: Cognitive robotic simulation for evaluating embodied social attention models
evidence.label: IEEE ICRA · 2025

evidence.title: Influence of robots' voice naturalness on trust and compliance
evidence.label: ACM THRI · 2025

evidence.title: The Robot in the Room: robot facial expressions and gaze in human-human-robot collaboration
evidence.label: IEEE RO-MAN · 2023

evidence.title: The Emotional Dilemma: a human-like robot, trust and cooperation
evidence.label: IEEE RO-MAN · 2023

zh.title: 人机交互与合作
zh.summary: 机器人的社会线索与具身性如何影响人机交互、共同任务以及人与机器人之间的合作？
zh.question: 机器人的社会线索如何影响合作、信任以及人们对机器人的评价？
zh.description: 我们在双人与多人任务中操控机器人的注视、面部表情、声音、模仿与人格特征，测量合作、服从、信任与感知智能等指标；认知机器人仿真则让我们在开展被试实验之前评估机器人行为。

title: Human-AI Interaction
summary: How do people experience and respond to AI, and how should emotional context and individual differences inform its behaviour?
question: What makes interaction with AI appropriate to the person, emotional context and purpose?
description: Beyond robots, we study voice assistants, conversational agents and LLM chatbots: how people respond to affective cues, how human strategies and user traits can inform emotion-aware, personalised design, and what AI-mediated social connection means for wellbeing.

evidence.title: Personalizing emotion-aware conversational agents? User traits-driven conversational strategies
evidence.label: IJHCI · 2026

evidence.title: Emotion-aware voice assistants through a role-swapping approach
evidence.label: HCII · 2025

evidence.title: Neutral by Default? Vocal responses to negative affective cues
evidence.label: ACM/IEEE HRI · 2026

zh.title: 人与人工智能交互
zh.summary: 人们如何体验人工智能并对其作出反应？情绪情境和个体差异应如何影响人工智能的行为？
zh.question: 如何使人与人工智能的交互适合参与者、情绪情境和交互目的？
zh.description: 在机器人之外，我们研究语音助手、对话智能体与大语言模型聊天机器人：人们如何回应情感线索，人类应答策略与用户特质如何指导具有情绪感知能力的个性化设计，以及 AI 介导的社会连接对身心福祉意味着什么。

title: Mechanisms of Social Cognition
summary: What makes a face, a gaze direction or a face-like object capture and guide attention - and which mechanisms explain that effect?
question: Which cognitive and neural mechanisms allow us to detect, attend to and evaluate social information?
description: We examine how faces, face-like patterns and gaze capture and orient attention, how cognitive control resolves conflict, and how fairness and empathy shape social evaluation, combining behavioural experiments, EEG and neuroimaging.

evidence.title: How face-like objects and averted-gaze faces orient our attention
evidence.label: i-Perception · 2025

evidence.title: Brain responses to self- and other- unfairness under resource distribution context: Meta-analysis of fMRI studies
evidence.label: NeuroImage · 2024

evidence.label: iScience · 2024

evidence.label: Under review · 2025

zh.title: 社会认知机制
zh.summary: 是什么使面孔、注视方向或类面孔物体捕获并引导注意？哪些机制可以解释这一效应？
zh.question: 我们依靠哪些认知与神经机制来觉察、注意并评价社会信息？
zh.description: 我们研究面孔、似脸图案与注视如何捕获并引导注意，认知控制如何化解冲突，以及公平与共情如何塑造社会评价，综合运用行为实验、脑电与神经影像方法。

title: Embodied AI
summary: How can models grounded in human behaviour become embodied systems whose perception and action can be tested in physical interaction?
question: How can models grounded in human cognition give artificial agents human-like perception and social behaviour?
description: We build models of attention, scanpaths and crossmodal learning from human data and examine human-centred affective AI, such as pain recognition. Attention models drive robot gaze and are evaluated on humanoid robots and in cognitive robotic simulation.

zh.title: 具身智能
zh.summary: 如何将以人类行为为基础的模型转化为具身系统，并在物理交互中检验其感知与行动？
zh.question: 如何让基于人类认知的模型赋予人工智能体类人的感知与社会行为？
zh.description: 我们基于人类数据构建注意、视觉扫描路径与跨模态学习模型，并探讨以人为中心的情感人工智能，如疼痛识别。注意模型用于驱动机器人注视，并在仿人机器人与认知机器人仿真中接受评估。
